# Scripted Gmail session for TestGmailTranscript (part of atrium's local patch).
# Hand-written from https://developers.google.com/workspace/gmail/imap/imap-extensions
# and RFC 3501; not captured from a live server.
#
# S: line sent verbatim by the server
# C: line the client must send exactly
# C/ regexp the whole client line must match
# {t} is the client's command tag: matched in C lines, substituted in S lines.

S: * OK Gimap ready for requests from 192.0.2.1 a1b2c3d4e5f6
C: {t} CAPABILITY
S: * CAPABILITY IMAP4rev1 UNSELECT IDLE NAMESPACE QUOTA ID XLIST CHILDREN X-GM-EXT-1 XYZZY SASL-IR AUTH=XOAUTH2 AUTH=PLAIN AUTH=PLAIN-CLIENTTOKEN AUTH=OAUTHBEARER
S: {t} OK Thats all she wrote! a1b2c3d4e5f6
C: {t} LOGIN "atrium.test@gmail.com" "app password"
S: {t} OK [CAPABILITY IMAP4rev1 UNSELECT IDLE NAMESPACE QUOTA ID XLIST CHILDREN X-GM-EXT-1 UIDPLUS COMPRESS=DEFLATE ENABLE MOVE CONDSTORE ESEARCH UTF8=ACCEPT LIST-EXTENDED LIST-STATUS LITERAL- SPECIAL-USE APPENDLIMIT=35651584] atrium.test@gmail.com authenticated (Success)
C: {t} SELECT INBOX
S: * FLAGS (\Answered \Flagged \Draft \Deleted \Seen $NotPhishing $Phishing)
S: * OK [PERMANENTFLAGS (\Answered \Flagged \Draft \Deleted \Seen $NotPhishing $Phishing \*)] Flags permitted.
S: * OK [UIDVALIDITY 1] UIDs valid.
S: * 4 EXISTS
S: * 0 RECENT
S: * OK [UIDNEXT 105] Predicted next UID.
S: * OK [HIGHESTMODSEQ 9123456]
S: {t} OK [READ-WRITE] INBOX selected. (Success)

# FETCH decoding: system, quoted, escaped, bracketed, modified UTF-7 and empty
# labels; ids above 2^63; item order differs per message.
C/ ^{t} UID FETCH 101:104 \(UID( (FLAGS|X-GM-MSGID|X-GM-THRID|X-GM-LABELS)){4}\)$
S: * 1 FETCH (X-GM-THRID 1278455344230334865 X-GM-MSGID 1278455344230334865 UID 101 X-GM-LABELS (\Inbox \Sent Important) FLAGS (\Seen))
S: * 2 FETCH (UID 102 FLAGS () X-GM-LABELS ("Muy Importante" "\\Inbox" "[Gmail]/Trash") X-GM-MSGID 17000000000000000001 X-GM-THRID 1266894439832287888)
S: * 3 FETCH (X-GM-LABELS ("&AOk-t&AOk-") UID 103 X-GM-MSGID 18446744073709551615 X-GM-THRID 18446744073709551615 FLAGS (\Seen \Flagged))
S: * 4 FETCH (UID 104 X-GM-MSGID 1 X-GM-THRID 1 FLAGS () X-GM-LABELS ())
S: {t} OK Success

# Unknown msg-att items are skipped: number, quoted, nested list, literal,
# NIL, flags, section and partial.
C: {t} UID FETCH 101 (UID X-GM-LABELS)
S: * 1 FETCH (UID 101 X-GM-FUTURE (1 "two" (3 4) {3}
S: abc NIL) FLAGS (\Seen \Flagged) X-GM-OTHER 99 X-FLAGLIKE (\Answered $Junk \*) X-SECTION[1.2]<0> "x" X-GM-LABELS ("q"))
S: {t} OK Success

# STORE X-GM-LABELS encoding.
C: {t} UID STORE 101 -X-GM-LABELS (\Inbox)
S: * 1 FETCH (UID 101 X-GM-LABELS (\Sent Important))
S: {t} OK Success
C: {t} UID STORE 101 +X-GM-LABELS ("Muy Importante" "&AOk-t&AOk-" "Back\\slash")
S: * 1 FETCH (UID 101 X-GM-LABELS (\Sent Important "Muy Importante" "&AOk-t&AOk-" "Back\\slash"))
S: {t} OK Success
C: {t} UID STORE 101:102 +X-GM-LABELS.SILENT (\Starred)
S: {t} OK Success
C: {t} UID STORE 101 X-GM-LABELS ()
S: * 1 FETCH (UID 101 X-GM-LABELS ())
S: {t} OK Success

# SEARCH keys.
C: {t} UID SEARCH X-GM-RAW "has:attachment in:unread"
S: * SEARCH 101 103
S: {t} OK SEARCH completed (Success)
C: {t} UID SEARCH UNSEEN X-GM-RAW "category:promotions" X-GM-MSGID 1278455344230334865 X-GM-THRID 1266894439832287888 X-GM-LABELS "Muy Importante"
S: * SEARCH 102
S: {t} OK SEARCH completed (Success)

# Unsolicited FETCH reaches the unilateral data handler with labels intact.
